NovaTech Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
Business Travel Policy
 Document ID
NT-FIN-005
Department
Finance
Version
1.8
Effective Date
01 June 2025
1. Booking Travel
All business travel must be booked through the company travel desk using the Travel Portal. Travel
requests must be raised at least 7 days before domestic travel and 21 days before international
travel. Last-minute bookings need written approval from the department head.
2. Air Travel
Economy class is mandatory for domestic flights and for international flights shorter than 6 hours.
Employees at Director level and above, and any employee on an international flight longer than 6
hours, may fly Premium Economy. Business class is allowed only with approval from the CEO.
3. Train and Road Travel
For train journeys, employees may travel in AC 2-Tier. Local travel by taxi or ride-hailing is
reimbursed with receipts. If a personal vehicle is used for business, the company pays Rs. 12 per
kilometre for cars and Rs. 5 per kilometre for two-wheelers.
4. Hotel Accommodation
Hotel limits per night are: Rs. 6,000 in Tier-1 cities (Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Chennai,
Hyderabad, Kolkata), Rs. 4,000 in other Indian cities, and USD 180 for international travel. Hotels
must be booked through the travel desk where possible.
5. Per Diem
A daily travel allowance (per diem) of Rs. 1,200 is paid for domestic travel and USD 50 for
international travel. This allowance covers meals and small incidental expenses; separate meal
claims cannot be made on the same day.
6. Travel Insurance
All international business travel is covered by the company's group travel insurance. Employees
must download the insurance certificate from the Travel Portal before departure.
Document Notice
Confidentiality Notice: This document is the property of NovaTech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. and is
intended for internal use by employees only. Unauthorised copying, sharing or distribution outside
the company is prohibited. For clarifications, contact the People and Culture team at
hr@novatech.example.
